Poet Tips Network — Reader Recommendations 2016–2019

About this view

What you're seeing: 6,095 poets from the Poet Tips recommendation website (2016–2019), connected by co-recommendation patterns: two poets are linked when users recommended them together.

Layout: node positions are a 2D projection computed by ForceAtlas2. Proximity is a layout artefact — it reflects graph connectivity, not literary similarity or canonical status.

Node size = PageRank in the co-recommendation network. Node colour = Louvain community (consensus across 20 random seeds). Faded nodes have unstable community assignments (below 70% seed agreement).

Bridge poets are the top 20 by weighted betweenness (using 1/weight as distance), all significantly above the degree-preserving null model.

Data coverage: 65% of poets matched to Wikidata; birth year available for 43% of all poets; gender from the dataset itself (99.4% coverage).

What this is not: a measure of literary quality, canonical status, or critical importance. It is a portrait of what Poet Tips users recommended to each other between 2016 and 2019.
